exercises.instructionEn: The Kite Battles
exercises.instructionUz: Varrak janglari
exercises.explanationUz:
MATN TARJIMASI:

1) Yaponiyaning Hamamatsu shahriga
tashrifimni hech qachon unutmayman.
May boshida borishga qaror qildim -
mahalliy odamlar varrak festivalini
o'tkazadigan vaqt. Har yili 3-5 may
oralig'ida mahalliy odamlar
bolalariga sog'liq, kuch va jasorat
keltirish uchun rangli varraklar
uchiradi. Yo'lda Hamamatsu varrak
festivali tarixi haqida biroz
o'qidim. Aftidan, hammasi taxminan
430 yil oldin, viloyat hukmdori
bolasining ismi yozilgan ulkan
varrakni osmonga uchirganida
boshlangan.

2) U yerga festival boshlanishidan
bir necha kun oldin kelganimda,
tayyorgarliklardan hayratda qoldim.
Ba'zi odamlar ulkan varraklar
yasardi, boshqalar yorqin rangli
aravalarni bezash bilan band edi.
Qayerga bormay, katta festival uchun
tayyorlanayotgan tort va shirinliklar
hidini sezardim. Ularni tatib
ko'rishga sabrim chidamasdi!

3) Festivalning birinchi kuni osmon
ulkan rangli varraklar bilan to'ldi.
Shunchalik hayajonlandimki, osmondan
ko'z uzolmasdim. "Jangning maqsadi, -
deb tushuntirdi bir chol, - sovrin
yutish emas, balki jamoalar boshqa
jamoalar varraklarini osmondan urib
tushirib, mahoratini ko'rsatishi." U
menga har bir jamoa yaqinda birinchi
farzand ko'rgan oila uchun varrak
uchirayotganini ham aytdi. Har bir
jamoa turli kostyumda ekanini
payqadim - ularga varraklaridagi
naqshlarga mos murakkab naqshlar
kashta qilingan edi. Ular boshlariga
sharf o'rashgan va qo'llarini varrak
iplaridan himoya qilish uchun qo'lqop
kiyishlari kerak edi. Varrak
jamoalari asosan erkaklar edi, lekin
yuzlab ayollar va bolalar tadbirni
tomosha qilishga kelgan edi. Muhit
ajoyib edi, atrofimda odamlar
to'xtovsiz bayroq silkitar, nog'ora
urar, karnay chalar va hushtak

tasks.uz: Varrak janglari

tasks.en: I'll never forget my visit to the Japanese city of Hamamatsu. I decided to go at the beginning of May, when the local people have their kite festival.
tasks.uz: Yaponiyaning Hamamatsu shahriga tashrifimni hech qachon unutmayman. May boshida borishga qaror qildim - mahalliy odamlar varrak festivalini o'tkazadigan vaqt.

tasks.en: Every year, between 3rd and 5th May, the local people fly colourful kites to bring their children good health, strength and courage.
tasks.uz: Har yili 3-5 may oralig'ida mahalliy odamlar bolalariga sog'liq, kuch va jasorat keltirish uchun rangli varraklar uchiradi.

tasks.en: On the way there I read a little about the history of the Hamamatsu Kite Festival. Apparently, it all started about 430 years ago, when the lord of the region sent a huge kite into the sky with his child's name on it.
tasks.uz: Yo'lda Hamamatsu varrak festivali tarixi haqida biroz o'qidim. Aftidan, hammasi taxminan 430 yil oldin, viloyat hukmdori bolasining ismi yozilgan ulkan varrakni osmonga uchirganida boshlangan.

tasks.en: When I arrived there, a few days before the beginning of the festival, I was amazed at the preparations involved. Some people were making enormous kites, while others were busy decorating brightly-coloured floats.
tasks.uz: U yerga festival boshlanishidan bir necha kun oldin kelganimda, tayyorgarliklardan hayratda qoldim. Ba'zi odamlar ulkan varraklar yasardi, boshqalar yorqin rangli aravalarni bezash bilan band edi.

tasks.en: Everywhere I went I could smell cakes and sweets cooking, ready for the big festival. I couldn't wait to try them!
tasks.uz: Qayerga bormay, katta festival uchun tayyorlanayotgan tort va shirinliklar hidini sezardim. Ularni tatib ko'rishga sabrim chidamasdi!

tasks.en: On the first day of the festival, the sky was filled with huge, colourful kites. I was so excited that I couldn't take my eyes off the sky.
tasks.uz: Festivalning birinchi kuni osmon ulkan rangli varraklar bilan to'ldi. Shunchalik hayajonlandimki, osmondan ko'z uzolmasdim.

tasks.en: "The aim of the battle," explained an old man, "is not to win a prize, but for the teams to show off their skills by knocking the other teams' kites out of the sky."
tasks.uz: "Jangning maqsadi, - deb tushuntirdi bir chol, - sovrin yutish emas, balki jamoalar boshqa jamoalar varraklarini osmondan urib tushirib, mahoratini ko'rsatishi."

tasks.en: He also told me that each team was flying a kite for a family who had recently had their first child.
tasks.uz: U menga har bir jamoa yaqinda birinchi farzand ko'rgan oila uchun varrak uchirayotganini ham aytdi.

tasks.en: I noticed that every team had different costumes, which were embroidered with elaborate designs to match the ones on their kites. They wore scarves around their heads and they had to wear gloves to protect their hands from the kite strings.
tasks.uz: Har bir jamoa turli kostyumda ekanini payqadim - ularga varraklaridagi naqshlarga mos murakkab naqshlar kashta qilingan edi. Ular boshlariga sharf o'rashgan va qo'llarini varrak iplaridan himoya qilish uchun qo'lqop kiyishlari kerak edi.

tasks.en: The kite teams were mostly men, but hundreds of women and children had come to watch the event. The atmosphere was fantastic, and all around me people kept waving flags, banging drums, playing trumpets and blowing whistles.
tasks.uz: Varrak jamoalari asosan erkaklar edi, lekin yuzlab ayollar va bolalar tadbirni tomosha qilishga kelgan edi. Muhit ajoyib edi, atrofimda odamlar to'xtovsiz bayroq silkitar, nog'ora urar, karnay chalar va hushtak chalardi.

tasks.en: At the same time, the teams were furiously tugging their opponents' kites to the ground. I couldn't help admiring them for putting on such a stunning show.
tasks.uz: Shu bilan birga, jamoalar raqiblarining varraklarini g'azab bilan yerga tortardi. Shunday ajoyib tomosha ko'rsatganlari uchun ulardan hayratlanmay ilojim yo'q edi.

tasks.en: On the last evening of the festival, I really enjoyed walking around the city centre and watching the floats. People had put an incredible amount of work into making them and they were really beautiful.
tasks.uz: Festivalning oxirgi kechasi shahar markazida sayr qilish va aravalarni tomosha qilish menga juda yoqdi. Odamlar ularni yasashga aql bovar qilmas darajada mehnat sarflagan va ular chindan go'zal edi.

tasks.en: It made me feel sad to think that I would leave for Tokyo the next day, but I knew that the memories of the kite festival would stay with me forever.
tasks.uz: Ertasi kuni Tokioga jo'nab ketishimni o'ylash meni xafa qildi, lekin varrak festivali xotiralari men bilan abadiy qolishini bilardim.

tasks.uz: Rok konsertiga borganmisiz? Men o'tgan shanba Bath yaqinidagi Pinecrest jamoat bog'ida bo'lgan konsertga bordim, va u ajoyib edi. Bu olti xil guruh, jumladan sevimli guruhim The Runners ishtirokidagi kun bo'yi davom etgan tadbir edi.

tasks.en: It was only nine o'clock in the morning when I got there, so I watched as they set up the speakers for the sound system. One of the men working there even asked me to help, so I ran over and gave him a hand.
tasks.uz: U yerga yetib borganimda ertalab soat to'qqiz edi, shuning uchun ular ovoz tizimi uchun karnaylarni o'rnatishini tomosha qildim. U yerda ishlayotgan erkaklardan biri hatto mendan yordam so'radi, shuning uchun yugurib borib unga yordam berdim.

tasks.en: The concert started at eleven o'clock, and since I had helped earlier I was allowed to sit at the edge of the stage. I was almost close enough to touch the performers. The best part of the concert for me was when The Runners appeared.

exercises.instructionUz: + to-infinitiv / -ing shakli / 'to'siz infinitiv
exercises.explanationUz:
INFINITIV yoki -ING? - JADVAL.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  + TO-INFINITIV                  ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  decide, want, would like, would
  love, begin, refuse, agree,
  expect
  stop (to do sth else) = boshqa
    ish qilish uchun to'xtamoq
  remember (not forget) = unutmaslik
  forget (not remember) = qilishni
    unutmoq

  'I decided TO GO.'
  'I would like TO VISIT.'


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  + -ING ShAKLI                   ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  love, like, hate, don't mind,
  look forward to, enjoy, couldn't
  help, can't stand
  stop (finish, give up) = tashlamoq
  remember (recall) = eslamoq
  forget (not recall) = eslamaslik

  'I enjoy WALKING.'
  'I'm looking forward to SEEING
   you.' ⚠ 'to' dan keyin -ing!


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  + 'TO'SIZ INFINITIV             ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  make, let, can, must, may, could,
  will, would

  'She made me LAUGH.'
  'Let me GO.'
  'I can SWIM.'


⚠ STOP - IKKI MA'NO:

  stop TO smoke = chekish uchun
    to'xtadi
  stop SMOKING = chekishni tashladi


⚠ REMEMBER - IKKI MA'NO:

  remember TO lock = qulflashni
    unutma
  remember LOCKING = qulflaganimni
    eslayman


⚠ FORGET - IKKI MA'NO:

  forgot TO send = yuborishni
    unutdim (yubormadim)
  forgot SENDING = yuborganimni
    unutdim (yuborgan edim)


⚠ 'TO REFUSE':

  = rad etmoq.


⚠ 'TO EXPECT':

  = kutmoq.

tasks.en: When we write an article about a celebration/event we attended, we can divide it into four paragraphs.
tasks.uz: Biz qatnashgan bayram/tadbir haqida maqola yozganda uni to'rt xatboshiga bo'lishimiz mumkin.

tasks.en: In the first paragraph, we write what celebration/event we attended and where and when it took place (place, date/time).
tasks.uz: Birinchi xatboshida qaysi bayram/tadbirga qatnashganimiz va u qayerda, qachon bo'lib o'tganini yozamiz (joy, sana/vaqt).

tasks.en: In the second paragraph, we write about the preparations before the celebration/event (e.g. costumes, food, etc.)
tasks.uz: Ikkinchi xatboshida bayram/tadbirdan oldingi tayyorgarliklar haqida yozamiz (masalan, kostyumlar, ovqat va h.k.)

tasks.en: In the third paragraph, we write what happened during the celebration/event.
tasks.uz: Uchinchi xatboshida bayram/tadbir davomida nima bo'lganini yozamiz.

tasks.en: In the last paragraph, we write how we felt. We normally use past tenses in such pieces of writing.
tasks.uz: Oxirgi xatboshida qanday his qilganimizni yozamiz. Bunday yozma ishlarda odatda o'tgan zamonlarni ishlatamiz.

tasks.en:
Last year I had a fancy-dress party for my birthday. It took place at my house on Saturday, 15th March, and it started at six o'clock in the evening.

Before the party, my mum baked a big chocolate cake and I decorated the living room with balloons. I also sent invitations to all my friends and asked them to come in costume.

During the party, everyone looked great in their costumes. We ate lots of delicious food, played party games and danced to loud music. Then I blew out the candles and everyone sang 'Happy Birthday'.

At the end of the party I felt exhausted, but I was really happy. It was the best birthday I have ever had.
tasks.uz:
O'tgan yili tug'ilgan kunim uchun maskarad bazmi o'tkazdim. U 15-mart, shanba kuni uyimda bo'ldi va kechqurun soat oltida boshlandi.

Bazmdan oldin onam katta shokoladli tort pishirdi, men esa mehmonxonani sharlar bilan bezadim. Barcha do'stlarimga taklifnoma yubordim va kostyumda kelishlarini so'radim.

Bazm davomida hamma kostyumlarida ajoyib ko'rinardi. Ko'p mazali ovqat yedik, bazm o'yinlarini o'ynadik va baland musiqaga raqsga tushdik. Keyin shamlarni puflab o'chirdim va hamma 'Happy Birthday' kuyladi.

Bazm oxirida holdan toygan edim, lekin juda baxtli edim. Bu men o'tkazgan eng yaxshi tug'ilgan kun edi.
